entries.label: P: “Marko Štrba is the CEO and Founder of OOX Limited, leading …”
entries.value: Marko Štrba is the CEO and Founder of OOX Limited, leading the company with clarity, ownership, and disciplined execution.He builds scalable systems and independent teams. He believes strong culture comes from hiring people who take ownership and work independently.

entries.label: P: “Marko focuses on financial discipline, rapid validation, an…”
entries.value: Marko focuses on financial discipline, rapid validation, and long-term adaptability. He drives strategy across game prototyping, mobile game development, and full-cycle production. He leads with calm accountability and a bias toward action over theory.
